description: Fetch up to 5 public URLs in one call and return each page's title, engine and a short snippet (first ~1200 characters), so an agent can triage several links quickly. When to use: search returned several candidate pages and you want a first pass over all of them; then call web_fetch on the ones worth reading in full. Do not use: when you need the complete text of a page (use web_fetch), or to crawl a site (use web_map). Returns: {ok, count, ok_count, results:[{url, ok, final_url, status, title, engine, chars, snippet, error?}], took_ms, _metering}. Partial failures do not fail the whole call. Metered: counts one call per URL against the shared web free bucket (50 URLs/day per IP together with web_fetch), then 1 credit per URL over x402 - max 5 URLs per call, no API key.

urls.description: 1-5 http(s) URLs to fetch in one call.
